title: edge ecb currency validity
assumptions: Join quoted currency to dated CLDR assignments only with publication date and tender policy. ECB quoted-currency scope and CLDR territory assignment scope differ. Currency/date does not determine a region. CLDR48 has 21 open-ended USD regional assignments, including US, EC and PA. Do not infer transaction region or aggregate multiplied quote rows as independent rates; any region selection or currency-only projection needs a later explicit policy.
expected_cardinality: One ECB currency/date quote to zero or many CLDR regional currency assignments valid on that date; preserve region and interval multiplicity
physical_role: Proposed contextual join; not executed or reconciled
